title: A min-stack and a hash set
hints: For the min-stack, keep a second array where position `i` holds the minimum of the first `i + 1` values; pushing computes it from the previous one, and popping needs nothing extra.
`Math.floorMod(hash, buckets.length)` always gives an index from 0, even for negative numbers. When resizing, every value must be placed again, because its bucket depends on the number of buckets.
